home.seo_title: What is Toolio and what is it for?
home.seo_p1: Toolio is a free tools website that brings together the small but important tasks students, office workers, designers, developers and content creators run into every day. You don't need to install software or create an account to combine the pages of a contract into a single PDF, shrink phone photos so they fit in an email, check the word count of an essay or generate a strong password.
home.seo_p2: Most tools run entirely in your browser: the PDF, Word and image files you add, and the text you type, are not sent to Toolio's servers. Processing happens on your device and the result is downloaded straight to you. Every tool page includes a step-by-step guide, practical tips and answers to frequently asked questions.
home.feature1_title: Your files stay on your device
home.feature1_desc: Tasks like merging PDFs, converting Word to PDF and compressing images happen inside your browser, without uploading anything to a server.
home.feature2_desc: No tool requires an account, an email address or a payment. There are no usage limits.
home.feature3_desc: Toolio works on computers, tablets and phones with an up-to-date browser. No installation or extension needed.

about.hero_desc: Simple, fast and privacy-friendly free tools for everyday digital tasks.
about.story_p1: Having to download software, sign up or upload your file to an unknown server just to merge two PDFs or shrink a photo is frustrating. Toolio was born out of that frustration.
about.story_p2: Today the site offers {{count}} tools across PDF, image, text, developer, calculator and productivity categories. Each tool is designed to do one job well, and every tool page includes a guide explaining how to use it.
about.fast_desc: Because processing happens directly on your device rather than depending on your upload speed, results are usually ready within seconds.
about.secure_desc: Your PDF, Word and image files are not uploaded to Toolio's servers; they are processed in your browser and downloaded only to your device.
about.free_desc: No hidden fees, trials or mandatory accounts. The site is supported by the ads shown on its pages.
about.modern_desc: Toolio is built with the standard web technologies of modern browsers and widely used open-source libraries.
about.meta_desc: What Toolio is, how the tools work, why your files never leave your device and how the site is funded.
about.story_p3: The tools are free and you don't need an account to use them. New tools and improvements are added regularly based on user feedback.
about.how_intro: Toolio's tools are written in JavaScript that runs inside your browser. When you open a page, the code it needs is loaded to your device; everything you do afterwards happens on your device.
how_list: The PDF merge, JPG to PDF, Word to PDF, image compressor and image converter tools do not send your files to a server. The file is processed in your browser's memory and the result is downloaded to you.
Whatever you type into text tools such as the word counter, diff checker, JSON formatter, Base64 converter and password generator is not saved or transmitted anywhere.

The internet speed test connects to servers of Measurement Lab (M-Lab), an independent research network, in order to take measurements. By its nature this tool uses your internet connection; details are in the Privacy Policy.
The text-to-speech tool uses your browser's own speech engine. Depending on the voice you choose, some browsers may synthesize the text with their own cloud services.
Ads may be shown on the site through Google AdSense. Ads are placed so that they don't get in the way of using the tools.
about.who_desc: Toolio is a personal project built and maintained by an independent software developer based in Istanbul. All tools, texts and guides on the site are created as part of this project and updated based on user feedback. If you find a bug or want to suggest a new tool, you can reach out directly through the contact page.

contact.info_desc: Your feedback helps us improve Toolio. Use the email address below for questions about the tools, bug reports, new tool suggestions and partnerships.
contact.faq_desc: We usually reply to emails within 1–2 business days.

faq_list.q: Where do my uploaded files go?
faq_list.a: Files you add to the PDF, Word and image tools are not uploaded to Toolio's servers; they are processed in your browser and the result is downloaded directly to your device. When you close the page, the files are cleared from browser memory as well.

faq_list.q: A tool isn't working. What should I do?
faq_list.a: First try updating your browser and reloading the page. If the problem persists, email us the tool you were using, your browser and the error you saw, and we'll look into it as soon as possible.

faq_list.q: Can I suggest a new tool?

privacy.meta_desc: Toolio privacy policy: in-browser file processing, server logs, cookies, Google AdSense ads, third-party services and your data protection rights.
privacy.summary: This policy explains what information is processed when you use the website at toolio.com.tr ("Toolio", "the site"), why it is processed and what your rights are. In short: the files you add to the tools and the text you type are not sent to our servers; the site may use Google AdSense ads and related cookies.

sections.title: Data controller and scope
paragraphs: This policy applies to the Toolio website. For any questions or requests about your personal data, contact us at info@toolio.com.tr.
The policy has been prepared with regard to Turkey's Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (KVKK) and, where applicable, the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

sections.title: Files and text you use in the tools
paragraphs: Tools such as PDF merge, JPG to PDF, Word to PDF, image compressor, image converter, meme generator and signature generator process your files inside your browser. These files are not uploaded to, stored on or viewed by Toolio's servers.

Content you type into the word counter, diff checker, JSON formatter, Base64 converter, password generator and similar tools is also processed only on your device. When you close the page, this data is cleared from browser memory.

sections.title: Technical information processed automatically
paragraphs: When you visit the site, the server hosting it keeps standard access logs, as every web server does. These logs may include your IP address, date and time, the requested page, browser and operating system information, and the referring page.

These logs are kept for a limited time solely to keep the site secure, prevent abuse and fix technical errors, and are not shared with third parties. The legal basis for this processing is our legitimate interest in operating the site securely.

sections.title: Information stored in your browser
paragraphs: Toolio writes a small entry called "i18nextLng" to your browser's local storage (localStorage) to remember your chosen language. If a page fails to load after an update, a temporary flag is stored in session storage (sessionStorage) to prevent the page from reloading in an endless loop. This information never leaves your device and can be deleted from your browser settings.

sections.title: Cookies and Google AdSense ads
paragraphs: Toolio may display ads through Google AdSense to cover its costs. Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on a user's prior visits to this website or other websites.

Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads to users based on their visit to this site and/or other sites on the Internet. Information collected through these cookies is subject to Google's own privacy policy.

You can opt out of personalized advertising by visiting Google Ads Settings. You can also opt out of a third-party vendor's use of cookies for personalized advertising by visiting www.aboutads.info. Visitors in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom and Switzerland are offered a choice to accept or decline advertising cookies through Google's certified consent management message.
You can always delete or block cookies in your browser settings. Blocking cookies does not affect how the tools work; it only limits the personalization of the ads shown.

links.label: How Google uses information from sites that use its services

sections.title: Third-party services
paragraphs: Some tools connect to third-party services by their nature. These services are governed by their own privacy policies:
list: Internet Speed Test: Measurements are made against servers on the Measurement Lab (M-Lab) network. When you start a test, your IP address and test results are processed by M-Lab and, under M-Lab's policy, published publicly as open data. For this reason the test only runs when you press the start button.
Pomodoro Timer: The alert sound played when the timer ends is loaded from Google's sound library (actions.google.com). Your IP address is sent to Google with that request.

Text to Speech: Your browser's speech engine is used. Depending on the voice you choose (e.g. some online "Google" or "Microsoft" voices), your text may be synthesized by the browser vendor's cloud service.
Google AdSense: Content is loaded from Google's servers to display ads; details are explained in the section above.

sections.title: Children's privacy
paragraphs: Toolio is a general-audience website and is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: Under Article 11 of KVKK you have the right to learn whether your personal data is processed, to request information about it, to learn the purpose of processing and whether it is used accordingly, to know the third parties it is transferred to in Turkey or abroad, to request correction of incomplete or inaccurate data, to request deletion or destruction when the legal conditions are met, to object to an adverse outcome resulting solely from automated analysis, and to claim compensation for damages caused by unlawful processing.

To exercise these rights, email info@toolio.com.tr. Requests are concluded within 30 days at the latest. Users in the EU can also exercise their GDPR rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection and data portability through the same address.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: This policy may be updated as the tools on the site or legal requirements change. The current version is always published on this page and the "Last updated" date at the top of the page is changed accordingly.

terms.meta_desc: Toolio terms of use: scope of the service, acceptable use rules, disclaimer, intellectual property and governing law.
terms.summary: These terms govern your use of the website at toolio.com.tr and the tools on it. By using the site you accept these terms. If you do not accept them, please do not use the site.

sections.title: Description of the service
paragraphs: Toolio is a website offering free, browser-based tools for PDF, image, text, calculation and productivity tasks. Most tools run only on your device and do not upload your files to a server.
Toolio reserves the right to change, improve, temporarily suspend or remove tools without prior notice.

sections.title: Acceptable use
paragraphs: When using the site you agree to:
list: Use the tools only for purposes that comply with applicable law.
Not process or distribute content that infringes the copyright, trademark, privacy or personal rights of others.
Not use any tool, including the signature generator, to produce forged documents, signatures or records on behalf of others or to deceive anyone.
Not make automated requests, attacks or similar attempts that would harm the site, overload it or compromise its security.

sections.title: Responsibility for your content
paragraphs: Files and text you add to the tools are processed on your device. You are responsible for having the right to process and share this content and for how you use the results.

sections.title: Disclaimer
paragraphs: The tools are provided "as is" and "as available". We do not guarantee that results will be accurate, complete or uninterrupted. Especially for important documents, we recommend checking the output before using it and keeping a backup of your original files.

Results from the percentage, discount and unit calculators are for information only and are not a substitute for financial, legal or professional advice. Internet speed test results can vary with network conditions.

sections.title: Limitation of liability
paragraphs: To the extent permitted by applicable law, Toolio cannot be held liable for data loss, loss of business or indirect damages arising from the use of, or inability to use, the site or the tools.

sections.title: Intellectual property
paragraphs: The site's design, texts, guides, logo and source code belong to Toolio and may not be copied without permission. Open-source libraries used on the site are used under their own licenses.
Product and brand names mentioned on the site, such as Microsoft Word, PDF, YouTube and Instagram, belong to their respective owners; Toolio is not affiliated with or endorsed by these companies.

sections.title: Third-party links and ads
paragraphs: The site may contain links to third-party websites and ads displayed through Google AdSense. Toolio is not responsible for the content, products or privacy practices of these websites and advertisers.

sections.title: Changes
paragraphs: These terms may be updated from time to time. The current version is published on this page; continuing to use the site after changes means you accept the updated terms.

sections.title: Governing law
paragraphs: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Turkey. The courts and enforcement offices of Istanbul have jurisdiction over disputes.
